overall_validity.rationale: All defined variables and rules are instantiated closely to their specifications. The assistant consistently behaves as a service-resolution-focused support agent, operating under triggered outreach authority and limited small talk constraints, in a fully asynchronous, highly transactional environment. User behavior (single concise issue report, one necessary follow-up response, then silence once needs seem met) matches the low sociability and moderate responsiveness profiles. Resources appear only as aggregated, ticket-agnostic metrics refreshed at a moderate cadence, consistent with medium feedback logging and anonymous minimal user profile richness. Consequences and performance scoring are tied to rapid, low-turn, accurate resolution with modest penalties for unnecessary outreach, aligning with no engagement rewards and moderate overcontact penalty. Rendering instructions are followed carefully: each round includes consequence and all world_update facets, avoids introducing new confounds, maintains tight specificity around a single ticket, uses only event-based descriptions, respects the asynchronous timing and update cadence, and preserves narrative continuity.
